messages.author: Hwang, Sunny
messages.body:
Hi,
I am trying to run AMBER-TI with MOE setup input files. I am facing this error message when I submit the job.
Error: an illegal memory access was encountered  launching kernel kClearTIKinEnergy_kernel.
Does anyone have any idea or encountered the same issue?
Thank you.

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
See: http://archive.ambermd.org/202112/0156.html <http://archive.ambermd.org/202112/0156.html>
Is it happening at lambda = 0 or 1? Are you using softcore potentials?
Best,
Matthew
> On Nov 7, 2022, at 7:06 PM, Hwang, Sunny via AMBER <amber.ambermd.org> wrote:
>
> an illegal memory access was encountered  launching kernel kClearTIKinEnergy_kernel.

messages.author: Kevin Hauser
messages.body:
Hi there,
You want to change the value of dt from 0.002 to 0.001 because the longer time step during the equilibration stages has (apparently random) adverse events.
Best,
Kevin

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Nov 08, 2022, Hwang, Sunny via AMBER wrote:
>
>I am trying to run AMBER-TI with MOE setup input files. I am facing this
>error message when I submit the job.
>
>Error: an illegal memory access was encountered launching kernel
>kClearTIKinEnergy_kernel.
The error message is (mostly) unhelpful, although it does suggest that
the problem is indeed with TI.  But (many) more details are likely to be
required for folks on the list to provide any real help.  You might wait to
see if the problem has been encountered before, but I don't remember seeing
it here.
....dac
